L1-0330.note: Separable verb shēng∥qì. The CEDICT second sense 'vitality' is the unrelated noun reading shēngqì and does not belong on an HSK 1 card.

L1-0332.note: Num. Dropped the redundant numeral form '10'.

L1-0333.note: N. Primary must not be bare 'time' (that is 时间 L1) nor 'moment' (collides with 一会儿). 时候 is the occasion/point at which something happens: 什么时候, ...的时候.

L1-0335.note: N. Kept 'matter' as primary so it stays distinct from 东西 'thing' and 事情 'affair'. Dropped the CL: clause.

L1-0336.note: V. At HSK 1 试 is 'try it' (试试 / 试一下). CEDICT leads with 'to test', which belongs to 考试/测试.

L1-0337.note: V. Dropped 'correct' — that sense is 对 L1, and a second gloss here only invites confusion with 对/不对.

L1-0338.note: No official POS. Described the function plainly rather than naming the A-not-A pattern.

L1-0339.note: N. Dropped 'personal' — that is the bound adverbial 手 of 手写/亲手, not an HSK 1 sense.

L1-0340.note: N. Both are the same sense in different Englishes; kept the second so a British learner recognises the card.

L1-0342.note: N. 'satchel' is dated register for a beginner card.

L1-0344.note: N. Dropped 'to cultivate' — a verb gloss on a noun-only card, and a literary sense at that.

L1-0345.note: N. Dropped 'River' (the CEDICT '(after a name) ... River' fragment), which was meaningless on a card.

L1-0347.note: V. Kept the bare verb here; 睡觉 (L1-0348) takes 'to go to bed' so the two cards stay distinguishable.

L1-0348.note: Separable verb shuì∥jiào. Primary deliberately differs from 睡 'to sleep' — the two are near-synonyms and would otherwise be one answer.

L1-0349.note: V. Dropped the scolding and 'doctrine' senses — wrong register and bound form.

L1-0352.note: V. Primary cannot be 'to give' — that is 给 L1. These are the three senses an HSK 1 learner actually meets.

L1-0353.note: M. Measure word for age; the noun 'year' is 年.

L1-0358.note: Adv. Primary must not be bare 'too', which a learner reads as 'also' and would answer 也. 'excessively' is unambiguous and matches the Adv POS.

L1-0359.note: N/M. Both senses are live at HSK 1 (三天 / 天气); 日 keeps 'sun' and 'day of the month'.

L1-0361.note: V. 'to heed' is the 听话 sense and too idiomatic to lead with; dropped the loanword 'a can' and the Taiwan readings.

meanings: to write down what you hear
L1-0364.note: V. 'to write down' alone is 写下 and collides conceptually with 写; 听写 is specifically the dictation exercise.

L1-0365.note: N. Reordered: 'classmate' is the everyday word. CEDICT sense 1 'to study at the same school' is a verb and wrong for the N row.

L1-0367.note: N. Dropped 'foreign' (bound form of 外国/外语). Gave the plain gloss to the single character and pushed 外边 onto a different primary.

L1-0368.note: N. Deliberately not 'the outside' — that strips to the same answer as 外 (L1-0367) and as 外面 (L3). 外边下雨了 = it is raining out there.

L1-0372.note: Adj. Dropped the noun senses 'evening/night' — 晚上 carries those.

L1-0373.note: N. 'dinner' is the natural primary; stays distinct from 午饭 'lunch' and 早饭 'breakfast'.

L1-0375.note: No official POS. Correct as shipped, second gloss added for clarity.

L1-0376.note: N. 'netizen' is dated and would puzzle a beginner.

L1-0384.note: N. Matches 东/南/北 at the same level.

L1-0386.note: V. Dropped 'to develop (photographs)', 'to shuffle' and 'to erase' — none is an HSK 1 sense.

L1-0387.note: N. Not 'bathroom' or 'toilet': 卫生间 L3 already ships both of those, and the two cards must stay separable.

L1-0389.note: N/V. Positional noun sense first to pair with 上; 下边 takes 'the underside' so the two do not collapse.

L1-0390.note: Separable verb xià∥bān. Dropped 'next service (train, bus)', which is 下班车 and not this entry.

L1-0391.note: N. Primary changed off 'under' so it does not strip to the same answer as 下 (L1-0389).

L1-0393.note: No official POS. Correct as shipped.

L1-0394.note: Separable verb xià∥kè. The CEDICT 'to be fired' sense is figurative sports slang and stays out.

L1-0396.note: No official POS. Primary reworded so it does not strip to the same answer as 雨 'rain' (L1-0449) — the two were an identical-meaning pair.

L1-0397.note: Adv. 你先走 = you go first. Not 'first of all' — 首先 L3 owns that. Dropped the '(prefix) my late ...' sense.

L1-0400.note: V. Primary cannot be 'to want' (要 L1) nor bare 'to think' (觉得 L1 is 'to think that'). All three senses are met at HSK 1: 我想想 / 我想去 / 我想你.

L1-0402.note: N. Primary must not be 'child' — 孩子 L1 already ships that. CEDICT only had an erhua cross-reference.

L1-0403.note: N. The CEDICT '(slang) prostitute' sense is excluded outright. Stays distinct from 女士 'lady' L4.

L1-0408.note: V. Both senses are genuinely met at HSK 1 and Chinese does not split them.

L1-0410.note: V. Official POS is V, so the verb form leads; 'thank you' follows as the everyday use.

L1-0411.note: Adj. Dropped the adverb 'newly' and the chemistry sense 'meso-'.

L1-0413.note: N. Dropped 'day of the week' and 'Sunday' — 星期 alone means the week; the weekdays are 星期一 etc.

L1-0416.note: V/Adj. The HSK 1 use is 行! = that works. CEDICT sense 1 'to walk; to go' is the bound literary form and belongs to xíng in compounds. Stays distinct from 好 'good'.

L1-0417.note: V. CEDICT sense 1 is the noun 'rest', wrong for a V row.

L1-0418.note: V. Left 'to study' off so 学习 L1 keeps it as its own primary.

L1-0422.note: N. Distinct from 大学 'university' and 小学/中学.

L1-0423.note: V. All three are HSK 1 uses (我要一杯水 / 要下雨了).

L1-0424.note: N. Kept the paternal marker because Chinese distinguishes 爷爷 from 外公.

L1-0425.note: Adv. Dropped 'even' — that is the marked 连...也 pattern, well beyond HSK 1.

L1-0426.note: M. Learner meets it as 第五页; the measure-word function is spelled out as the second gloss.

L1-0429.note: N. 医生 is the standard word; 大夫 L3 is the colloquial synonym.

L1-0432.note: No official POS. Reworded off 'a moment' as primary: 一会儿 also appears at L2 (Adv) and shipped byte-identical glosses. This L1 card is the duration noun (等一会儿); the L2 Adv row should take 'in a moment / now ... now ...'.

L1-0433.note: N/Adv. Near-synonym of 一起, which keeps the plain 'together'. Differentiated so the two are not one answer.

L1-0434.note: No official POS. Post-verbal softener (看一下儿). Kept clear of 一点儿 'a little' and 一会儿 'a short while'. The L5 一下儿 row is the different 'all at once' sense.

L1-0435.note: Adj. Distinct from 相同 'identical' L2.

L1-0436.note: N/Adv. Second gloss covers the 一边...一边... pattern (一边走一边说) in plain words.

L1-0437.note: No official POS. Correct as shipped; CEDICT had only an erhua cross-reference.

L1-0438.note: Adv/N. Adverbial sense leads; 一块儿 is pushed onto a differentiated primary.

L1-0440.note: V. Dropped 'to need', which only surfaces in the negative 不用, and the coverb and courteous-eating senses.

L1-0441.note: V. Both are core HSK 1; dropped the bound '-ful/-ed' gloss.

L1-0444.note: Adv. Covers both listed variants 有时候 and 有时.

L1-0446.note: V. Official POS is V, so the bare adjective 'useful' cannot lead the card.

L1-0447.note: N. The shipped gloss 'right, the direction' carried an internal comma, which the UI renders as two senses. 'right-hand side' also avoids the correct/right ambiguity with 对 and stays distinct from 右边.

L1-0449.note: N. Kept the plain noun; 下雨 was reworded instead so the pair is no longer one answer.

L1-0450.note: M. "yuan" is the entry's own toneless pinyin and cannot ship on any gloss of this card. 块 keeps the spoken equivalent, 钱 keeps "money".

L1-0452.note: N. 'month' leads because 月亮 L2 owns 'the moon' and because HSK 1 meets 月 mostly in 三月 / 一个月.

L1-0453.note: Adv. Primary moved off bare 'again' so it does not collide with 又 L2. 再 is the not-yet-happened 'again' (再说一遍); 又 is the already-happened one.

L1-0454.note: Official POS is V, but 'goodbye' is the only honest learner-facing primary — a verb-shaped gloss like 'to say goodbye' would point at 告别 instead. Flagged as a hard case.

L1-0455.note: V/Prep/Adv. Verb sense leads to match POS order; the preposition follows. The progressive 在 is carried by 正在, so it is not repeated here.

L1-0457.note: Adj. Dropped the noun 'morning' — 早上 owns that — and the greeting.

L1-0460.note: Pron. Dropped 'what?' — that is 什么, and leaving it here makes two cards share an answer.

L1-0461.note: N. Dropped 'website' (that is 网站 L2) and the verb 'to stand' (the separate 站 L2 V row).

L1-0462.note: V. 'to look for' is the natural primary; 找到 keeps 'to find' as the result.

L1-0463.note: No official POS. Correct as shipped — the resultative of 找.

L1-0464.note: Pron. Dropped 'these' so 这些 keeps it.

L1-0469.note: Aux. Described the function in plain words rather than naming the aspect particle; kept distinct from 呢 and from 了.

L1-0470.note: Adv/Adj. Primary moved off 'really' because 真的 L1 already ships that; 'truly' keeps the adverb POS.

L1-0472.note: Adv. The shipped 'straight / upright' is the adjective sense and belongs to the 正 L3 Adj row — the two levels were swapped. 我正吃饭呢.

L1-0473.note: Adv. Reworded off 'to be in the process of', a verb-shaped gloss on an Adv row, and kept distinct from 正 above.

L1-0476.note: N. Dropped the '(dialect) OK' sense. Primary is 'the middle part' so it stays separable from 中间 'the middle', 中心 'center' and 内 'within'.

L1-0483.note: Adj. The chóng reading 'again / to repeat' is the separate 重 L3 row.

L1-0485.note: V. Primary qualified so it does not read as 生活 'to live / life'. Dropped the resultative-complement sense.

L1-0486.note: V. CEDICT sense 1 is the noun 'preparation', wrong for a V row.

L1-0488.note: N. 'letter' alone is misleading for 字 and 'word' belongs to 词 L2; 汉字 L1 keeps 'Chinese character'. Dropped the courtesy-name sense.

meanings: noun suffix on objects and people
L1-0489.note: Suffix. Reference row is 子（桌子）. Qualified so it does not read identically to 头 L2 'noun suffix on place words'.

L1-0490.note: V. Dropped the euphemistic 'to die' and the compound-verb 'away'.

L1-0492.note: Adv. The shipped primary 'best or most extreme example' is CEDICT's 之最 parenthetical — a noun phrase on an Adv row and not what 最 does before an adjective.

L1-0493.note: Adv. Official POS is Adv, so the adjectival 'best' cannot lead; 你最好早点儿去.

L1-0494.note: N. Noun sense leads to match POS; 'final' was an adjective gloss on a noun row.

L1-0496.note: N. Mirrors 右 and stays distinct from 左边 'the left side'. Dropped the political, geographic and variant-character senses.

L1-0498.note: V. The second sense (坐飞机, 坐车) is core HSK 1 and was missing. Dropped 'to bear fruit' and the 座 variant note.

L1-0499.note: No official POS. Correct as shipped.

L1-0500.note: V. The shipped 'to make / to write' takes CEDICT senses 1 and 2 and misses the everyday sense; 做作业, 做什么.

L2-0001.note: Aux, neutral tone. This is the sentence-final modal particle, not the exclamation 啊 ā (the separate L4 Intj row) — so the shipped 'exclamatory particle / ah!' was the wrong entry's meaning.

L2-0002.note: N. Qualified so it is not answered by 爱 L1 'to love'.

L2-0005.note: Adj/N. Adjective leads to match POS order.

L2-0006.note: N. The 'fig. reactionary / anti-communist' sense is political CEDICT baggage and is excluded. Qualified so it is not answered by 白 'white'.

L2-0007.note: N. 'squad leader' is the military sense; a learner meets this in a classroom.
